notes: Server --predict -1 and --timeout -1 are preserved. The client independently caps each response at 8192 tokens and each case at 600 seconds; smoke has a 600 second aggregate budget including server startup.
No claim that --reasoning auto forces reasoning on each response. The client preserves server_default behavior; enabled means no disable override.
One explicit parallel slot prevents dividing the requested 262144 context among concurrent sequences.
All three GGUF shards, the executable, adjacent llama.cpp DLLs, and the pinned CUDA runtime DLLs are hashed locally before launch. No model/runtime download or backend fallback.
The campaign prepends the pinned CUDA runtime directory to PATH for both the version probe and the owned server process; no manual shell PATH mutation is required.
